%s 말이에요.\n나한테 동전 세 닢 빚졌는데…\n안 받을래요. 그냥 줄:
It's about %s.
Owed me three coins…
I won't collect. It's a gift now.
Forgiving a debt is
how goblins say goodbye.
%s.
We used to pick scrap together.
No more halves. Just me now.
고블린은 원래 도망을 잘해요.\n근데 %s, 안 도망갔대요.\n…바보같이:
Goblins are good at running.
But %s didn't run, they say.
…Stupid. Stupid.
It sounds like an insult.
It's praise.
%s 소식 들었어요.\n키 큰 쪽이 쓰러지면\n고블린은 숨을 데가 없어요:
I heard about %s.
When the tall ones fall,
goblins have nowhere to hide.
A people who speak
even grief in sums.
%s, 저한테 한 번도\n값 깎아 달란 적이 없었어요.\n…좋은 손님이었:
%s never once asked me
for a discount.
…A good customer, that one.
어젯밤 %s 일 말이에요.\n무덤에 동전 하나 두고 왔어요.\n…진짜 동:
About %s last night.
I left a coin on the grave.
…A real coin. Really.
벽에 금 간 거 열한 군데요.\n제가 세어 봤어요.\n고치는 값은… 묻지:
Eleven cracks in the walls.
I counted.
The repair cost… don't ask.
That face has already
finished the sum.
지붕 판자 굴러다니던데\n제가 주워 놨어요.\n돌려 드릴게요. 거의 다요:
Roof planks were rolling around,
so I picked them up.
I'll give them back. Most of them.
If the lodge falls, I've got
nowhere to go either.
So let's fix it. Together.
그 서리 거미요? 니벨라?\n죽었다고요? 진짜로요?\n…그 둥지, 뭐 남:
That frost spider? Nivella?
Dead? Really, truly?
…Anything left in that nest?
Loot comes before
mourning, for this lot.
니벨라 다리가 여덟이었죠.\n여덟 개 다 셌어요, 멀리서.\n아주 아주:
Nivella had eight legs.
I counted all eight, from afar.
Very, very far.
할머니가 그랬어요.\n북쪽 거미 이름은 부르지 말라고.\n니벨라! 니벨라:
Grandma always told me:
never say the north spider's name.
Nivella! Nivella! …Ah, that felt good.
Only after two shouts
do the shoulders drop.
어젯밤 몇 마리였는지 알아요?\n쉰까지 세다 놓쳤어요.\n쉰 넘으면 다:
Know how many came last night?
I lost count at fifty.
Past fifty, it's all 'lots'.
솔직히 말할게요.\n어젯밤엔 짐 싸려고 했어요.\n…근데 짐이 너무 많아:
I'll be honest.
Last night I tried to pack up.
…But I had too much stuff.
Through all that chaos,
the lodge held up.
That wood is worth a high price.
안개 끼면 동전도 안 보여요.\n어젯밤 하나 떨어뜨렸는데\n…아침에 찾았:
In fog you can't see coins.
I dropped one last night…
…found it this morning. Phew.
안개 속에서 뭐가 자꾸\n제 이름을 불렀어요.\n대답 안 했어요. 똑똑하:
Something in the fog kept
calling my name.
I didn't answer. Smart, right?
I hate fog. It's free.
Whatever comes for free
always takes something back.
An old reckoning
of goblin traders.
이제 밤이 두 개 남았죠?\n하나, 둘. 손가락 두 개.\n…세기 쉬워서:
Two nights left, right?
One, two. Two fingers.
…Nice and easy to count.
The folded fingers
shake a little.
끝나면 저 뭐 받아요?\n아니, 돈 말고요.\n…여기 다시 와도 돼요?:
What do I get when it's over?
No, not money.
…Can I come back here?
마지막엔 다들 비싸져요.\n장작도, 화살도, 용기도요.\n저는 싸게 팔게:
At the end, everything gets dear.
Firewood, arrows, courage.
I'll sell you courage cheap.
There's no meat in the soup.
I stirred three times, and
three times, just broth.
고기 떨어졌죠?\n제 주머니에 육포가… 있었는데.\n언제 먹었지?:
Out of meat, huh?
I had jerky in my pocket… once.
When did I eat that?
고기 한 덩이에 동전 넷.\n장터 시세예요. 구해 오면\n…다섯 쳐 드릴:
Four coins a slab of meat.
Market price. Find some and
…I'll pay you five.
어젯밤 아무도 안 다쳤어요!\n붕대 하나도 안 썼어요.\n남은 거 제가:
Nobody got hurt last night!
Not one bandage used.
Can I keep the leftovers?
Quiet nights are weird.
My ears keep trying to count
but there's nothing to count.
Everyone's in one piece,
so I can laugh today, right?
…Heehee. There.
